# Auto-generated prettier chain signature. Do not edit manually.
# Regenerate: deno task fixtures:update:formatted <pattern>
#
# Each %%PASS=N%% section is exactly prettier^N(unformatted_ours_<suffix>.<ext>),
# the same-suffix source beside this file. It exists when prettier's output from
# that source is claimed by no single-form marker — a chain with two or more
# distinct intermediates, or a fixed point no documented stable form holds.
# See docs/fixture_overview.md (rule N12) and crates/tsv_debug/src/fixtures/audit_signature.rs.

%%PASS=1%%
<script lang="ts">
	// a comment written last inside a redundant pair down the update clause's right edge stays
	// in the header after the update, ahead of a comment written after the pair
	for (
		;
		;
		a +
		b // c1 // d1
	) {}

	for (
		;
		;
		a +
		b /* d2 */ // c2
	) {}

	for (
		;
		;
		a +
		b
		// c3 // d3
	) {}

	for (
		;
		;
		a +
		(b +
			c) // c4 // d4
	) {}

	for (
		;
		;
		i++,
			a +
				b // c5 // d5
	) {}

	for (
		i = 0;
		i < n;
		i =
			i +
			j // c6 // d6
	) {}

	// a multi-line block takes the same place
	for (
		;
		;
		a +
		b /* c7
		 */ // d7
	) {}

	// with nothing after the pair, the comment trails the update as before
	for (
		;
		;
		a +
		b // c8
	) {}

	for (
		;
		;
		a &&
		b // c9 // d9
	) {}

	// in an operand or declarator that another follows, the comment trails its comma
	for (
		;
		;
		i++,
			a +
				b, // c10
			j++ // d10
	) {}

	for (
		i = 0,
			k =
				a +
				b, // c11
			j = 1;
		;
	) {}

	for (
		let i = 0,
			k =
				a +
				b, // c12
			j = 1; // d12
		;
	) {}

	// the last declarator's value keeps its comment as before
	for (
		let k =
			a +
			b; // c13
		;
	) {}

	// a pair around a whole declarator value is the header's own shell, kept as before
	for (
		let i = 0,
			k = b, // c14
			j = 1;
		;
	) {}

	// a pair the printer adds ahead of a keyword, or an index, holds the comment, which
	// stays ahead of the one after it
	for (
		;
		;
		(a +
			b) as T // c15 // d15
	) {}

	for (
		;
		;
		f(a)[
			b +
				c // c16
		] // d16
	) {}

	// a block written after a sequence's last pair follows the comment too
	for (
		;
		;
		i++,
			a +
				b /* d17 */ // c17
	) {}
</script>

<script lang="ts">
	// a comment written last inside a redundant pair down the update clause's right edge stays
	// in the header after the update, ahead of a comment written after the pair
	for (
		;
		;
		a + b // c1 // d1
	) {}

	for (
		;

		a + b /* d2 */ // c2
	) {}

	for (; ; a + b)
	// c3 // d3
	{}

	for (
		;
		;
		a + (b + c) // c4 // d4
	) {}

	for (
		;
		;
		i++, a + b // c5 // d5
	) {}

		i = 0;

	) {}

		 */ // d7
	) {}

	) {}

		;

	) {}

	for (

		;
